verdict.rationale: Alloy documents real-time decisioning on transaction events, which supports screening a payment before release. It lists interdicting on transactions as a use case and returns Source Workflow results in the evaluations[] array of the Events response, so the decision can be inspected. Inspecting the supporting matches behind that decision (e.g., watchlist or sanctions hits) is not documented; the services object only shows vendor execution status. missing for 10: documented match-level detail (screening hits) for a payment decision, explicit hold/release flow for payments, compliance-officer UI for inspecting the decision, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can screen a payment before release and inspect the decision and its supporting matches

citations.quote: Alloy supports dozens of use cases like interdicting on transactions
Alloy's Events API allows you to build a real-time integration for decisioning on suspicious ongoing behavior as soon as it happens.
Alloy will return results of the Source Workflow under the evaluations[] array in the Events response.
Monitors transaction events in real time or at scheduled times to detect suspicious activity, apply policy logic, and generate alerts or investigations when thresholds are met.
